notes.title: Demo Patch 1.4
notes.notes: [p]Implemented Xbox controls and remapped the menu.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.3
notes.notes: [p]After receiving some feedback, the ghost calls were removed. Players felt them being stuck listening to a call without the option to skip slowed down the pace. Instead the player now has the option to walk past proximate activated radios that will give them hints on what to do, where to go, and give them story beats. [/p]
